Variants.Content: The martial House of Châtillon held the counties of Saint-Pol and Blois. Stalwart champions of Louis IX on the Seventh Crusade, their banners spearheaded royal vanguards from Champagne to Egypt with unmatched chivalric devotion.
The red-and-ermine shields of Châtillon signaled resolute heavy cavalry shock across every major royal campaign.
